title: Absolute Binding Affinity of a Phospholipid for a Membrane Protein: Alchemical Free Energy Calculations at Atomistic Resolution
authors: Ezry Santiago-McRae; Omri Sheffer; Wayland W.L. Cheng; Jérôme Hénin; Grace Brannigan
one_liner_zh: 该文用自由能微扰计算膜蛋白与磷脂的绝对结合亲和力，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-配体结合自由能计算方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Specific lipid binding is a likely mechanism by which phospholipids may modulate the conformational ensembles of membrane proteins. An absolute binding affinity is the natural quantitative descriptor for such interactions, but has not been directly accessible. Erwinia ligand-gated ion channel (ELIC) is a lipid-sensitive model for the pentameric ligand-gated ion channel protein family. ELIC is sensitive to palmitoyl-oleoyl phosphatidylglycerol (POPG) in model membranes, and densities from cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) resemble ordered phospholipids near the protein-membrane interface. Here, we present precise binding affinities for occupancy of this density by POPG, using an atomistic implementation of our Streamlined Alchemical Free Energy Perturbation (SAFEP) method. Achieving convergence required computationally inexpensive collective variables that were robust to the flexibility of phospholipids. POPG shows weak non-ideality in a binary POPC:POPG membrane, with excess chemical potentials that are slightly weaker for 10-30% POPG. Non-ideality in the bulk membrane negligibly affects predicted binding, due to the strong binding affinity (-9.7+/-0.8 kcal/mol). These results align with previous binding free energy estimates and show robust convergence across several metrics. They are also consistent with the strong non-bonded interactions between POPG and the protein, not observed with POPC. This affinity quantifies the equilibrium binding of the glycerol backbone, a necessary but insufficient condition for modulation. Unbiased simulations reveal that when the backbone is bound, the headgroup can adopt at least two distinct conformations, each interacting with protein residues with established functional implications.
abstract_zh: 特异性脂质结合是磷脂调节膜蛋白构象集合的一种可能机制。绝对结合亲和力是此类相互作用的自然定量描述符，但此前无法直接获取。Erwinia配体门控离子通道（ELIC）是五聚体配体门控离子通道蛋白家族的一个脂质敏感模型。ELIC对模型膜中的棕榈酰-油酰磷脂酰甘油（POPG）敏感，低温电子显微镜（cryo-EM）密度显示在蛋白质-膜界面附近存在有序磷脂。在此，我们利用原子级实现的流线型炼金术自由能微扰（SAFEP）方法，呈现了POPG占据该密度的精确结合亲和力。实现收敛需要计算成本低廉的集体变量，这些变量对磷脂的柔性具有鲁棒性。POPG在二元POPC:POPG膜中表现出弱的非理想性，其中10-30% POPG的过量化学势略弱。由于强结合亲和力（-9.7+/-0.8 kcal/mol），体相膜中的非理想性对预测结合的影响可忽略不计。这些结果与先前的结合自由能估计一致，并在多个指标上显示出稳健的收敛性。它们也与POPG与蛋白质之间的强非键相互作用一致，而这种相互作用在POPC中未观察到。该亲和力量化了甘油骨架的平衡结合，这是调节的必要但非充分条件。无偏模拟揭示，当骨架结合时，头部基团可采取至少两种不同构象，每种构象均与具有既定功能意义的蛋白质残基相互作用。
